d: A hall in the Doge's palace of Venice. In front of Gothic verons, from which it can see part of the city and the lagoons clear of the moon. To the right of the spectator two doors, one that puts in the apartments of the Doge, the other at the common entrance; to the left two other doors that lead to the courtroom of the Council of the Ten, and to the prisons of state. The whole scene is illuminated by two wax torches, supported by wooden arms protruding from the walls. The Council of Ten and Junta that are gathering.
Said, Barbarigo and Loredano, who enter the municipality.
Loredano and Barbarigo.
Jacopo Foscari who comes from the prison preceded by the Knave, between the two Commanders.
Jacopo and the two Guard Commanders.
Says and the Knave who comes from the Council.

Upper atrium in the Palazzo Foscari. There are several doors around with portraits of the prosecutors, senators, etc., of the Foscari family. The bottom is all pierced by Gothic arches, through which you can see the Canalazzo, and far away the ancient bridge of Rialto. The hall is illuminated by large leaning headlights in the middle. Lucrezia exits precipitous from a room, followed by the Handmaids who seek to hold it.
Dettale and Pisana coming crying.
Members of the Council of Ten and Junta from the courtroom.

Private cabinet of the Doge. Start a large table covered with damask, over a silver lumina; a desk and various cards; next to a large high chair. The Doge, once entered, abandons himself on the high chair.
Said and a Servant, then Lucrezia Contarini.
The prisons of state. Little light enters from a window practiced in the high wall. Jacopo Foscari sitting on a marble boulder.
Detto and Lucrezia Contarini.
The Doge wrapped in ample black cloak enters the prison, preceded by a Servant with torch, who lays down and leaves.
Said and Loredano preceded by the Council Knave and by four Custodians with torches.
Council Hall of Ten. The Councillors and the Junta, among which is Barbarigo, are gathering.
Said and the Doge, who preceded by Loredano, the Knave of the Council and the Commanders, and followed by the Paggi, goes seriously to sit on the throne. He sits, everyone does the same.
Said and Jacopo, who enters between four Custodians.
Detti and Lucrezia Contarini show up on the threshold with his two Sons, followed by several Dames his friends and Pisana.

The ancient Piazzetta di San Marco. The canal is full of boats that come and go. In front of it you can see the island of Cipressi, now San Giorgio. The sun turns to the occasion. The scene, at first empty, is filled with people and masks, which come in from various parts, meet, recognize, walk. Everything is joy.
Said, Loredano and Barbarigo masked aside.

Said. From the ducal palace two trombettieri followed by the great Messer. The trombettieri sound, and the People withdraw. Even the boats disappear from the canal, where a jail is advanced, on which the banner of St. Mark waves.
The Sopracomito disembarks from the prison, to which the Messer grande delivers a sheet. From the ducal palace then slowly leaves among the Custodi Jacopo Foscari, followed by Lucrezia and Pisana.
Doge's private office as in the first act. The Doge enters afflicted.
Said and Barbarigo coming in hasty, carrying a sheet.
Said and Lucrezia desolate.
Said, and a Servant.
That said, Barbarigo and the members of the Council of the Ten and Junta, among whom is Loredano, who seriously enter and then bowed down the Doge, if they arrange around him.
Said and Lucrezia.
